retouch_prompt: LIGHT-TOUCH SCREENSHOT RETOUCH ONLY. The attached image is the edit target, a real AresRPG game screenshot. Preserve every pixel-art texture pattern, large angular polygon leaf clump, voxel cliff face, flat color surface, thick dark outline, camera and all geometry. DO NOT repaint or reconstruct the scene. Do not add leaves, grass, vines, moss, flowers, rocks, buildings, clouds or any detail not in this screenshot. Do not smooth shapes or replace flat stylized surfaces with realistic texture. Keep the exact low-detail game-renderer style. Adjust exposure and local contrast mildly to make the existing shapes read more crisply; reduce some blue haze; add only very subtle warm sunlight and a few soft translucent sun shafts. The result should look like this same engine with a better color grade, not a cinematic remaster or photorealistic Minecraft image. Preserve the full original 16:9 composition. No text, logo, UI or watermark.
note: Original captures were removed; camera settings remain in sources/cameras.json. WebP exports use quality 88, width 1600. Valley uses the stricter retouch prompt. Geometry, outlines and camera are to be preserved; only lighting and clarity are enhanced.

Preserve the game's pixel-textured surfaces. No new objects, people, architecture, labels, text, logos, UI, watermark, photorealism, smooth geometry, excessive bloom or oversharpening halos.
